 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Jyoti Singh
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. This is a petition filed on behalf of the Petitioner under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of FIR No. 453/2022 dated 21.06.2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS: New Ashok Nagar.
4. As per the averments made in the present petition, Petitioner and Respondent No. 2 are both practicing Advocates with some professional experience behind them.
Court is also apprised at the outset that in a transfer petition pending before the Supreme Court, parties have been referred for mediation.
This Court is also hopeful that the parties might amicably resolve their disputes.
This is a digitally signed order.

5. Issue notice.
6. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
7. Status report be filed within four weeks from today.

8. Notice be issued to Respondent No. 2, through all permissible modes, returnable on 27.03.2024 who shall remain present in Court on the next date of hearing so that efforts can be made to amicably resolve the disputes between the parties.
Petitioner shall also remain present in Court on the next date of hearing.
Since there are possibilities of the matter being amicably resolved, the Trial Court is requested to adjourn the next date of hearing to a date beyond the date fixed by this Court.
JYOTI SINGH, J FEBRUARY 14, 2024/shivam
